evidence: The ALD cycle was similar to our previous report with the optimized plasma exposure for 1.5 s. The temperature of DMAH source was set to 40°C and the RF power during deposition was 400 W . The thickness of Al2O3 passivation layer was chosen to be 25 nm to ensure suppressed migration of OH – and to require minimal cycles and deposition time. The deposition temperature was varied from 100°C to 300°C. Reactive ion etching was then performed to create the contact holes. Finally, post -annealing was done in O 2 ambient for 2 h at 300°C.
